条件工作流程

此工作流程使用 mikudes 的条件节点来实现分辨率预设/ksampler/检查点加载器以及您可以想象的任何内容

工作流程将其与定制组合 （beta）节点以实现多预设选择。

在此工作流程中，我使用它来实现以下目标：

  • 在 2 个完整工作流程之间切换（下：杰出的上：anima）

  • 定义分辨率预设并一键轻松切换

您还可以调整此设置以使采样器预设或其他或保存您最喜欢的提示、种子、cfg 和步骤设置等...或将其扩展为具有 [x] 可供选择的工作流程“预设”数量

o.en:
Conditional Workflow

This workflow uses conditional nodes by mikudes in order to achieve resolution presets/ksampler/checkpoint loader and anyting you can imagine

The workflow is using it in combination withCustom Combo (beta) node in order to achieve multi preset selection.

In this workflow I used it to achieve the following:

  • Switch between 2 whole workflows (bottom: illustrious top: anima)

  • define resolution presets and easily switch between them in one click

You can also adjust this to makeksamplerpresets or other or save your favorit prompts, seeds, cfg & steps settings etc... or extend it to have [x] amount of workflow "presets" to choose from
